scope: Read-only independent source review and fresh production-path focused regression suite for opt-in Swarm verified-checks completion. No live-speed verdict.

resolved_findings.finding: Cancellation could occur during the awaited post-verifier source snapshot before durable host output.
resolved_findings.resolution: AbortSignal and lease are checked immediately after both awaited snapshots. Dedicated cancellation/lease-expiry controls cover both boundaries.

resolved_findings.finding: First independent focused run rejected the new negative-control fixture before its intended verifier gate.
resolved_findings.resolution: Fixture declares the existing mandatory parallelSafe flag. Configuration guards and test assertions remain unchanged; the final real negative-control audit now runs and rejects the weak verifier.

reviewed_boundaries: Explicit pinned profile opt-in; default path has no extra completion probe.
Every named current check observation requires an owned successful receipt; pending effects, queued batches and saved replies drain first.
Full verification must bind the exact artifact and contain every required check once, without any additional non-PASS verdict.
UNKNOWN intent persists before verification; own feedback/check churn cannot rearm the same material candidate.
Source, cancellation and lease guards are rechecked after async boundaries.
Failed/unknown probes resume the same attempt; later scheduler verification and integration remain fresh.
Operations, programme and theoretical authorities retain normal completion conservatively.
limitations: The policy is suitable only for finite opt-in tasks whose immutable checks define all required outcomes.
It adds a full verification pass before existing fresh scheduler verification/integration. Expensive full verifiers can cost more than the avoided model acknowledgment.
This review covers the source/tested Swarm path, not a native CLI completion rewrite, installation into running sessions, or a live speedup.
Fresh broad repository gates and a separately frozen new experiment remain the integration owners responsibility.
